8.5 Expected Interfaces
In this chapter all interfaces required from other modules are listed. The PDU router module is modeled as a generic module that can interface to different upper and lower modules. The approach taken to model this generic approach is to have a virtual module called GenericComServices. This virtual module contains a set of APIs that the PDU router will call in upper layer or lower layer modules. These APIs are generic in the way that they contain a tag <Lo>, <Up> and <LoTp> that is replaced with the interfaced module. The tag is set by the configuration in the PduRBswModules container using the PduRBswModuleRef reference parameter.
